findings.title: fsync failure no longer treated as fatal.
findings.body: The old code used `maybe_fatal_err("delta_layer sync_all")`, which aborts the process on fsync errors that leave page cache state undefined. The new code turns the failure into an ordinary error, so the caller can retry and treat unsynced data as durable. Keep `.maybe_fatal_err(...)` before mapping the error.

findings.title: fsync failure no longer treated as fatal.
findings.body: Same problem as in delta_layer: dropping `maybe_fatal_err("image_layer sync_all")` turns fsync errors into recoverable errors and risks silent data loss. Restore the fatal check, then map the error.

findings.title: Invariant assert turned into a recoverable error.
findings.body: `lsn_range.start <= lsn` used to be an assert. A violation means a caller bug, and it now only returns an error that callers may swallow or retry. Unless this change is intentional, keep the assert.
